Name: Ability Shield
Description: Your Ability cannot be affected or changed in any way.

Name: Air Balloon
Description: You are Immune to Ground-Type Moves until you are hit by a non-Ground Type Move, whereupon it pops.

Name: Amulet Coin
Description: You earn 10% more Poké from Mission Rewards.

Name: Assault Vest
Description: Your Sp.Def modifier increases by 3, but you cannot use Status Moves.

Name: Big Root
Description: When you heal from Moves that drain foes of HP, restore an additional 1d6.

Name: Binding Band
Description: Whenever you inflict the Trapped Condition, the target takes an additional 1d6 per turn.

Name: Bright Powder
Description: Whenever you are targeted by a Move, roll a d6. On a 5-6, the attacker is Blinded. Has 10 uses, before it is consumed.

Name: Clear Amulet
Description: Your Stats cannot be lowered by another Pokémon.

Name: Destiny Knot
Description: If you become Infatuated, the Pokémon that Infatuated you is now Infatuated by you.

Name: Eject Button
Description: If your Stats are lowered, you can use a Reaction to leap 2 tiles away without provoking Opportunity Strikes.

Name: Expert Belt
Description: Your Super-Effective Moves deal an additional 1d6 damage. This additional Die  cannot score a Critical Hit. However, your Not Very Effective Moves deal 1d6 less  (to a minimum of 1).

Name: Flame Orb
Description: User has the Burned Condition when they hold it.

Name: Float Stone
Description: User has the Levitate Rare Quality when they hold it.

Name: Grip Claw
Description:
Whenever you inflict the Trapped Condition, the target cannot make a Status 
Resist Check for the first turn they are trapped.

Name: Heavy-Duty Boots
Description: You cannot be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rocks, or Traps

Name: Iron Ball
Description: You cannot benefit from Flying or Levitating.

Name: Lagging Tail
Description: You always go last in a Round of Battle.

Name: Leek
Description:
Farfetch'd and Sirfetch'd holding this item Score a Critical Hit on a 5-6 on all 
their Physical Moves.

Name: Life Orb
Description: You take 1d6 damage per Round of Battle you hold this (taken at end of turn), but your Moves have their Move Power increased by 1.

Name: Light Clay
Description: Your Reflects and Light Screens persist for 10 Rounds instead of 5.

Name: Lucky Punch
Description: Chansey and Blissey holding this item Score a Critical Hit on a 5-6 on all their Physical Moves.

Name: Protective Pads
Description: You suffer no effects from Abilities that trigger off you dealing Physical Damage

Name: Quick Claw
Description: When you start a Round of Battle, roll a d6. On a 6, your Moves have Priority.

Name: Red Card
Description: If you are damaged by a Pokémon, present this Item as a Reaction. They are warped away to a different part of the Floor. This consumes the Item.

Name: Rocky Helmet
Description: Attackers that damage you with a Physical Move take 1d6 damage.

Name: Shed Shell
Description: You do not trigger Opportunity Strikes by moving out of range of a Foe.

Name: Sticky Barb
Description: Holder takes 1d6 damage at the start of their turn in Battle.

Name: Terrain Extender
Description: Your Terrain Moves persist for 10 Rounds instead of 5.

Name: Throat Spray
Description: After using a Sound-Based Move, you use this Item as a Reaction, and gain Sp.Atk Up 2. You can only use this Item once per Battle, and it has 10 total uses before it is consumed.

Name: Toxic Orb
Description: User has the Poisoned Condition when they hold it.

Name: Utility Umbrella
Description: You are unaffected by Rain and Harsh Sunlight.
